title.narrative: Tax Administration Reform Project in Uzbekistan

description.narrative: The development objective is to improve the operational efficiency and effectiveness of the State Tax Committee (STC) and increase voluntary compliance.

The development objective of the Tax Administration Reform Project for Uzbekistan is to improve the operational efficiency and effectiveness of the State Tax Committee (STC) and increase voluntary compliance. The project comprises of four components. The first component, automation of core tax administration business processes is to enhance the operational efficiency of the STC. The second component, reduction of the informal economy is to develop and implement a pragmatic road map to improve operational effectiveness and help reduce the size of the informal economy in Uzbekistan. The third component, strengthen human resources (HR) and institutional capacity for tax administration and delivery objectives are to strengthen the STC's HR institutional capacity to attract, develop, and retain a skilled and knowledgeable workforce, and develop the skills of tax officials. The fourth component, supporting project management objective is to provide support for project implementation, including the project's monitoring and evaluation, application of environmental and social standards, project related audits, training, and financing of incremental operating costs.

title.narrative: Share of women in managerial positions at STC in headquarters and the regional offices (% total managerial positions)

comment.narrative:
The target value is not on track to be achieved.
As of October 1, 2025: Number of management employees - 1,409, of which 25 positions are held by women or 1.8% Breakdown of positions held by female managers: Head and Deputy Head of Department, Head of Division in central apparatus - 2, Heads and Deputy Heads of city and district inspectorates - 8, Head and Deputy Head of Division, Head of Sector in district inspectorates – 16.
It is important to note that in November 2023, the indicator was 5.6%, the total number of management positions was 2,233, and women occupied 125 of them. Today, the indicator is at 1.8% for the following objective reasons. As part of the administrative reform in the public sector, significant changes were made to the structure of the Tax System at the beginning of 2024. In 208 regional district tax inspectorates, the existing structure of 12 departments was optimized and transformed into a structure of 4 departments.

target.value: Manuals for all modules of tax system developed

comment.narrative:
The target value is on track to be achieved.
This indicator includes measures to enhance the IT infrastructure at STC starting with an overarching ICT strategic plan and include upgrading data center, introducing cyber security protocols, an audit case management module, etc.

actual.value: 1. Four new information systems were developed and implemented in 2025 to improve taxpayer convenience, simplify tax calculation processes, and ensure timely detection and prevention of shadow economic activity. 2. In 2025, 8 new services were launched in the Taxes mobile application (“Accounting for marking codes”, “Purchase reports”, “Conducting on-site inspections”, “Reimbursement (refund) of VAT amounts”, “Concert and entertainment activities”, “Sale of agricultural products”, “Determination of a ban on travel”, “Regional electrical networks”) (6 services were introduced in 2023, 7 services were launched in 2024) 3. Integration with Information Systems has been ensured for 70 ministries (16 departments were added in January-September 2025, 13 departments in 2024, 9 departments in 2023) in 330 areas (71 areas in 2025, 35 in 2024, 24 areas in 2023).

target.value: Core team – composed of men and women - trained and entrusted permanently with tax analysis.

comment.narrative:
The target value may be achieved only partially.
This indicator covers measures taken to enhance the analytical capacity to measure tax gap and tax expenditures. The ultimate objective is to have a core team – later to be part of the fiscal institute - entrusted with this function.
Analysis is being carried out, with the help of Bank and IMF experts. For instance, VAT tax gap is being estimated annually as well as revenue forgone on other tax instruments.

actual.value: Within the framework of technical assistance of the World Bank, two seminars devoted to the analysis of tax gaps were previously held, the origin of the concept of tax expenditures, assessment of tax expenditures, the basic basis, revenue losses due to tax expenditures were considered. Seminars were held by IMF experts on the topic of determining the estimated volume of potential tax revenues and the share of lost taxes, the VAT tax gap.
